incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: novahealth-vpc — elevated 5xx and latency on dedicated pool 'novahealth-pool-2'. Canary rollout to rnw-artifact-2026-04-08-9c4f. Severity: P2. Oncall: Alice (Oncall)

Alice (Oncall): I'm on it, joining the call now. Can someone paste the earliest error spikes?

Caroline (SE): Novahealth SOC called at ~08:12 UTC: users seeing timeouts and malformed JSON outputs from chat endpoint. They said it started ~08:06 after our canary roll. They've put traffic on the dedicated pool.

Ben K (Infra): Metrics: GPU mem pressure and 502/500s on inference pods in novahealth-pool-2. 3 pod restarts last 6m. node gpu-12 shows sustained 95% memory.

Eve (ML Eng): Canary artifact: rnw-artifact-2026-04-08-9c4f — this switched to the new 4-bit matmul kernel. Repro locally with seq_len=2048 shows KV cache misalignment producing garbled tokens.

Eve (ML Eng): Logs snippet from canary pod:
```
2026-04-08T08:07:10Z ERROR decode_kv_cache: mismatch dims expected (64,512) got (63,512)
2026-04-08T08:07:10Z WARN generation: truncating output due to invalid past_key
2026-04-08T08:07:11Z ERROR model: runtime exception at matmul_4bit_fast
```

Dave (SRE): TL;DR - canary artifact seems regressively incompatible with longer seq lengths that Novahealth hits. We should isolate tenant and pin them back to last known-good artifact: rnw-artifact-2026-03-28-b2a1. Plan: 1) Quarantine canary traffic for novahealth, 2) Pin routing for novahealth tenant to the pinned artifact, 3) Rollback canary on pool or pin the pool to older artifact, 4) Run smoke tests, 5) Monitor for 15m, then update customer.

Caroline (SE): Customer asked for immediate rollback. They want confirmations for impact window and whether any data was lost.

Alice (Oncall): I'll start the tenant isolation now. @Ben K can you take the infra steps to pin the pool? @Eve can you prepare the artifact ID and rollback commands?

Ben K (Infra): Starting: setting pool routing rule to direct novahealth->pinned artifact. Using rcli: 
```
rcli routes update --tenant novahealth --pool novahealth-pool-2 --artifact rnw-artifact-2026-03-28-b2a1 --mode pin
```
Applying now.

deploy-bot: Staged routing change initiated by Ben K. Rollout: apply -> canary-limit 100 -> target tenant override.

Ben K (Infra): applied. Confirming 200 response from control plane.

Alice (Oncall): Initiating isolation: switching novahealth routing to dedicated pinned variant and removing them from canary path.

Eve (ML Eng): Verified artifact exists and checksum matches: sha256: ab12cd34ef56. Smoke test with sample prompt (seq_len=2048):
```
> curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\
  -d '{\"model\":\"novahealth-llm\",\"input\":\"<long prompt>\"}' \\
  https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq .output
```
Result: now returns coherent tokens, no kv/cache errors on the canary-reverted nodes.

Dave (SRE): Observability: 1m error rate dropped from 7% to 0.8% within 3m after pin. GPU mem on node gpu-12 dropped to 72% and pod restarts ceased.

Caroline (SE): Drafting customer note: \"We observed an instability introduced in a recent canary artifact that affected long-sequence inference. We rolled back Novahealth to the previously pinned model; service is stable. We'll follow up with RCA and mitigation plan.\" Agree?

Alice (Oncall): Yes. Add ETA for full postmortem: 48h. Also mention no customer data loss detected — all requests returned errors but no persisted corruptions.

Caroline (SE): Sending now.

Ben K (Infra): Deploy bot reports traffic policy updated. Can confirm control plane pinned tenant routing.

deploy-bot: Canary revert completed for tenant override rnw-artifact-2026-03-28-b2a1 -> status: success. 

Dave (SRE): Monitoring window started. Setting alert to check for regression for next 30m.

Alice (Oncall): I'm going to hand this over to @Zach for overnight monitoring in 20m. Key artifacts: canary artifact rnw-artifact-2026-04-08-9c4f (bad), pinned artifact rnw-artifact-2026-03-28-b2a1 (good). Links:
- Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/novahealth/metrics
- Incident runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/tenant-isolation

Zach (Oncall-night): Acknowledged handoff. I'll watch the error rate, latency, and pod restart counts. If we see >1% error sustained for 5m, I'll escalate to SRE lead.

Eve (ML Eng): Follow-ups: 1) disable the new 4-bit kernel on the model or add additional validation for seq_len > 1024; 2) run null-op regression tests across sample tenant workloads before promoting canary; 3) add model-level gating in the compilation path.

Dave (SRE): We'll schedule a postmortem with infra + ML + SE. Assigning action owners: Ben (infra) - adjust deployment gating, Eve (ML) - fix kernel or add guard, Alice (oncall) - verify runbook clarity, Caroline (SE) - customer comms and follow-up.

Caroline (SE): Customer acknowledged and said service is functional again; asked for a timeline on the postmortem. We'll aim for 48h.

Alice (Oncall): Closing the live incident channel. If any regression occurs, reopen this thread or page @SRE. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Incident action log updated: tenant_override_pin -> rnw-artifact-2026-03-28-b2a1 by Ben K at 1767001350.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (P2) — novahealth-vpc. Time to resolution: ~22m. Follow-up: postmortem scheduled within 48h.
